class: Any safety guard (an if-refuse/block/raise that protects money or state) with no test that fails when the guard is removed can be deleted or weakened in a later change with the suite still green; the guard's protection then depends on nobody touching that line.
mechanism: Builders wrote tests for the behaviours named in the ACs and the attacks in the brief, not for every guard they added; independent verifiers deleted guards one at a time and the suite stayed green.

first_seen.evidence: M3 (report share differs from stored) and M5 (fill resets last_observed_at) removed: 76 of 76 tests passed

fix: Per instance: W-021, W-023 (rounds 4-6, test-only), W-027 regression tests added until every listed mutant was killed. Mechanism: builder brief quality-bar line 'Every guard has a test that dies without it' (list each guard, delete it in a scratch copy, name the killing test).

detection.note: Verifier mutation runs catch it per item; no automated mutation-testing gate in CI (a stdlib mutation script over backend/ofo guard lines would guard it).
